hypothesis: Replacing ambiguous reduced-denominator workload lower bounds with source-validated external-fold multiplier predictions lets exact-C distinguish whether identical recent success rates came from short or long appearances, improving temporal reliability without using validation order or labels.

candidate.decoder_training_features: leave-one-season-out within each outer training history
candidate.decoder_validation_features: models fit only on seasons strictly before the validation year
candidate.route: R only; every F prediction remains the corresponding exact-C prediction bit-for-bit
candidate.selection: maximize minimum full gain across 2022/2023 and exact-C, lower-only C, honest identity, and honest grid anchors; then minimum R gain; then smaller gamma

development.on_fail: Close without generating or reading a 2024 decoder candidate.
development.on_pass: Write immutable gamma and artifact hashes before one 2024 confirmation run.
